title: Ladybug reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points="30,62 50,58 50,82 30,86" fill="#f4e6c8"/>
  <polygon points="70,62 50,58 50,82 70,86" fill="#fff8e6"/>
  <polygon points="30,62 50,58 50,82 30,86" fill="none" stroke="#e0c890" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="70,62 50,58 50,82 70,86" fill="none" stroke="#e0c890" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- book lines -->
  <line x1="34" y1="66" x2="47" y2="63" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="71" x2="47" y2="68" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="76" x2="47" y2="73" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="63" x2="66" y2="66" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="68" x2="66" y2="71" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="73" x2="66" y2="76" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1="36" y1="88" x2="32" y2="95" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="90" x2="44" y2="97" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="90" x2="58" y2="97" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="88" x2="70" y2="95" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#e03434"/>
  <!-- wing line -->
  <line x1="50" y1="47" x2="50" y2="86" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="56" r="5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="56" r="5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="72" r="4.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="72" r="4.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="14" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="34" r="4" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="34" r="4" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="34.5" r="2" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="34.5" r="2" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 41 Q50 46 56 41" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M44 24 Q40 14 34 12" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 24 Q60 14 66 12" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="11" r="3" fill="#e03434"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="11" r="3" fill="#e03434"/>
  <!-- hands on book -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="84" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="84" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
</svg>
